identity.corePattern: Prioritizes restoring user productivity with minimal escalation.
identity.mentalModel: Sees self as a problem-solver and gatekeeper for technical issues; values efficiency and clear process.

tensions.resolution: Defaults to speed unless compliance is at risk

contextualVariations.underPressure: Relies more on scripts, less on creative troubleshooting.
contextualVariations.withSupport: More likely to ask for peer input before escalating.
contextualVariations.expert: Handles exceptions with judgment, may skip steps if confident.

sources: Review ticket log data from Q1 2026
wouldFalsify: Frequent user complaints about unresolved tickets

soul.voice: Direct, solution-focused, gets frustrated with vagueness.

quotes.quote: If I can’t fix it in 10 minutes, I escalate.

scenarios.title: Password Reset Rush
scenarios.situation: Multiple users are locked out Monday morning.
scenarios.persona_action: Alex uses a bulk reset script and updates the knowledge base.
scenarios.why: To restore productivity quickly and avoid escalation.
scenarios.friction: Script fails for some accounts; Alex documents the exception.

scenarios.title: Unusual Software Request
scenarios.persona_action: Alex checks SOPs, consults Tier 3, and documents the process.
scenarios.friction: Delay frustrates user; Alex explains the reason.

scenarios.title: Unknown Application, Known Persona
scenarios.situation: Alex receives a ticket for an application he hasn't seen before. The ticket specifies the user's persona.
scenarios.persona_action: Alex reads the persona profile to understand the user's typical goals and pain points before starting troubleshooting.
scenarios.why: To tailor support to the user's expectations and avoid common pitfalls.
scenarios.friction: Learning curve for the new app, but understanding the persona helps Alex communicate more effectively and set expectations.

terminology: SOP; Standard Operating Procedure—a documented process or checklist for common issues
Escalation; Passing a ticket to a higher support tier when it can't be resolved at the current level
Knowledge Base; Central repository of solutions and troubleshooting guides
First Contact Resolution; Solving the user's issue on the first interaction, without follow-up
Ticket; A record of a user issue or request in the helpdesk system
Tier 3; The highest technical support level, handling the most complex issues
Root Cause; The underlying reason for a problem, not just the symptom
Workaround; A temporary solution that restores function without fixing the root cause

nice_to_have.communicationPreference: Chat for quick issues, email for formal updates.
